title: How to Calculate Water Requirement for a Family (Tank Capacity Calculator Logic)
metaTitle: How to Calculate Water Requirement for a Family - Tank Capacity Calculator Logic
description: Learn how to calculate the water requirement for your family and determine the appropriate tank capacity using our easy-to-follow formula and tank size calculator logic.
bodyHtml:
Choosing the right water tank capacity for your home is not just about buying the biggest tank available. An oversized tank increases cost and space usage, while an undersized tank leads to frequent water shortages—especially during summers or irregular municipal supply.

In this guide, you’ll learn how to accurately calculate water requirement for a family, understand tank capacity calculator logic, and choose the ideal water storage tank for your home. We’ll also explain why Prayag is considered one of the best water storage tank manufacturers in India.

Why Calculating Water Requirement Is Important

Before selecting a tank, it’s essential to know:

  • Your daily household water consumption

  • Number of family members

  • Water supply frequency

  • Whether water is used only for domestic use or also for gardening, washing cars, or RO systems

Correct calculation helps you:

  • Avoid water shortage 🚿

  • Reduce water wastage 💧

  • Increase tank lifespan

  • Optimize space and cost

Standard Water Requirement per Person (India)

As per commonly accepted urban household norms:

👉 Standard planning value: 135 litres per person per day (LPCD)

Water Tank Capacity Calculator Logic (Step-by-Step)

Step 1: Count Family Members

Example:
Family size = 4 members

Step 2: Multiply by Daily Water Requirement

Daily water use = 4 × 135 = 540 litres/day

Step 3: Decide Storage Days

This depends on water supply:

  • Daily supply → 1 day backup

  • Alternate day supply → 2 days

  • Irregular supply → 3–4 days

Assume 2 days backup.

Step 4: Final Tank Capacity Calculation

540 × 2 = 1080 litres

✅ Recommended tank size: 1000L – 1200L

Quick Water Tank Size Calculator Table

Additional Factors That Affect Tank Size

1. Bathroom Count

More bathrooms = more water usage
Add 10–15% extra capacity

2. Washing Machine & Dishwasher

Front-load machines use less water; top-load use more

3. RO Water Purifier

RO systems reject water → add 50–100 litres/day

4. Gardening & Car Washing

Add 100–200 litres/day if applicable

Overhead vs Underground Tank Capacity

💡 Many Indian homes use both—an underground tank for storage and an overhead tank for daily use.

Why Tank Quality Matters as Much as Capacity

Even the correct size tank fails if the quality is poor. A good water tank must be:

  • Food-grade & safe for drinking

  • UV stabilized (for rooftop use)

  • Leak-proof & crack-resistant

  • Strong enough for Indian climate conditions

This is where choosing the right manufacturer becomes crucial.

Why Prayag Is the Best Water Storage Tank Manufacturer in India

Prayag has built a strong reputation across India for high-quality water storage tanks designed specifically for Indian households.

Key Reasons to Choose Prayag Water Tanks

  • ✅ 100% virgin food-grade plastic

  • ✅ Multi-layer construction for strength & hygiene

  • ✅ UV-stabilized outer layer for long outdoor life

  • ✅ Crack & leakage resistant

  • ✅ Available in multiple capacities (500L to 10,000L+)

  • ✅ Trusted brand with pan-India presence

Whether you need a small overhead tank for an apartment or a large underground tank for a bungalow, Prayag offers reliable, long-lasting solutions.

Example: Ideal Tank Selection for a 4-Member Family

  • Family members: 4

  • Daily usage: 540 litres

  • Backup needed: 2 days

  • Recommended size: 1000L – 1200L Prayag Water Tank

This ensures uninterrupted supply even during water cuts or low-pressure days.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

❌ Buying tank based only on price
❌ Ignoring future family expansion
❌ Not considering water supply frequency
❌ Choosing non-food-grade tanks

Final Verdict

To calculate water requirement for a family:

  1. Use 135 litres per person per day

  2. Multiply by family size

  3. Multiply by number of backup days

  4. Add buffer for appliances & extra usage

And when it comes to choosing a reliable, safe, and durable water tank, Prayag stands out as one of the best water storage tank manufacturers in India, offering the perfect balance of quality, capacity, and long-term performance.
